use_when: Reconsider a costly or rejected route against an existing result contract.
not_for: Unknown target; generic meaning questions; automatic delegation to multiple agents.
requirements: No fixed executable or ENV contract established by the pilot; contextual resources remain unknown.

use_when: Extract PDF text/tables, manipulate pages, or generate and visually verify Python PDFs.
not_for: Standalone OCR; complex React layouts; assuming every operation covered by an OASF parent term is implemented.
requirements: Python and pdfplumber/pypdf/reportlab as applicable; pdftoppm for render verification. Versions, installation and path-specific minimum requirements are not checked.

use_when: Review a selected diff, branch or PR in an explicitly chosen review mode.
not_for: Treating pack-only L1 as completed review; assuming external reviewers or MCP are available.
requirements: Git, Serena/LSP and grep baseline; named reviewer roles; optional graph producers and external reviewers depend on mode. Availability and authorization are not checked.

use_when: Inspect review prerequisites; consider provisioning only as a separately authorized operation.
not_for: Producing code-review findings; treating script success as proof of session or model readiness.
requirements: Bash and Git; graphify/ast-grep/rg via source-specific setup; conditional external CLI/auth checks and Serena canary. Nothing is probed or provisioned by the card.

use_when: Maintain test-first discipline where the project explicitly declares TDD.
not_for: Non-TDD projects; generic testing tutorials; silently adding TDD to a review-only workload.
requirements: Project-specific test runner and project rules; no fixed executable/version requirement established by the pilot.
